title: AI tool detects pulmonary embolism on CT angiography and recovers cases missed in reports
summary: The CINA-PE algorithm was applied to 1204 retrospectively collected CTPAs from 230 US cities and 57 scanner models, with ground truth from three expert radiologists. Per-case sensitivity was 93.9% and specificity 94.8%, with per-finding positive predictive value 89.5%. It detected 22 of 29 positive cases not mentioned in the clinical report, lowering the miss rate from 15.6% to 3.8%; the study is retrospective and evaluates a commercial tool without outcome data.
ai_technology: CINA-PE, an AI algorithm detecting and highlighting suspected pulmonary embolism on CT pulmonary angiography

evidence.tested: Retrospective evaluation of 1204 CTPAs against three-radiologist majority ground truth.
evidence.unknown: Prospective effect on patient outcomes and workflow; independence from the vendor; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: A commercial AI algorithm flagged suspected pulmonary embolism on CTPA.
